 By Zack , Jen Rothery , +3 more Updated : Nov 17, 2026 4:53pm UTC Add IGN on Google Fuses are an item that you can add to your base to help protect your property
in Rob Run . The more fuses you have, the higher your defenses are against other players, who can use Decoders to break into your place. Finding these fuses can be tricky, especially if you're trying to gather up equipment to protect yourself. Read on to discover how to get fuses while playing Rob Run.
 Where to Get Fuses in Rob Run 
 The best way to get fuses is by buying them from the Black Market . You can find them for sale under the Construction Tab, in the Basic Goods section. 
 You can buy the most basic green fuses when you have a level 1 Settlement house and have at least $10,000. This unlocks basic fuses, and then you need to spend $20,000 to buy them. 
 The basic fuses add a point to your home's defenses. Homes have a base starting defense level. For example, your level 1 Settlement house has five points in defenses, meaning another player needs at least five Decoders to break into it. When you add a basic fuse to your home security network, you've now got six points, and other players will need six Decoders, or two Epic Decoders, to break into it.
 The standard rarity fuse gives just one defense point, but the epic rarity fuse increases your defense by three points, and the legendary fuse increases your defenses by five points. 
 To unlock the epic fuse, you'll need a level 2 Settlement house and $150,000, while the legendary fuse requires a level 3 Settlement house and $500,000.
Alternatively, you can get legendary fuses from the Suspicious Door at Lenny's Motel. You can exchange one epic fuse and $250,000 for a legendary fuse. How to Use Fuses 
 When you have any of the three fuses, approach the Security System of your house, fence, or any of the additional pieces of property you've added to your home, such as the Grow House. Each of these has a different Security System that you can interact with, and other players will need to bypass them to access your stuff.
 When you interact with it, you'll open up a window where you can place new fuses on the left side, increasing your home's defenses. 
 You can see the defense number at the top, next to the house icon. 
 Below those are alarm systems, which give you (and others who are in your clan) 
a notification that someone is trying to break into your property. You only get this notification if you're online, though.
